about: Requests her food sign-ups are measured by (src/lib/miriamFoodSignup.test.ts), against that test's calendar. want: "<event key>/<item>" — what a sign-up should be; "taken:…" or "theirs:…" — the item is someone else's, or already theirs; "food" — a sign-up, but nothing she can plainly confirm; "phone" — what only the app knows (her briefing's suggestion); "-" — not a sign-up. "review": found by reviewing her, written to fail. "unseen": written after her examples were last added, before seeing how she reads them. None may be one of her examples (functions/src/miriam/own/skills.ts).
